- [LFST.8.2] Envelope decoding needs only the envelope .proto (ships
  with the runtime). Tools can extract `seq`, `clock_ns`,
  `event_id`, and the oneof tag (event kind) —
  from the first byte, before any schema has been
  announced. This is the floor a reader always has, not a
  ceiling: once the announcements arrive, slot values
  become readable too ([LFST.8.10]).
